cards.front: Yesterday, I _______ salad for lunch as it was said to be good for my health.
cards.explanation: Yesterday shows a finished time in the past, so use the Past Simple.

cards.front: I _______ to bed early last night to get enough sleep for a healthy lifestyle.
cards.explanation: Last night is a finished past time, so use the Past Simple.

cards.front: Last weekend, I _______ hiking with friends. It _______ such a nice outdoor activity.
cards.explanation: Last weekend refers to a completed past time. Both actions are completed in the past, so use the Past Simple for both verbs.

cards.front: Up to now they _______ to get enough sleep every night to promote good mental and physical health.
cards.explanation: Up to now connects the past with the present, so use the Present Perfect.

cards.front: Minh _______ this supplement before. It is bitter to him.
cards.explanation: Before, with no finished past time stated, refers to life experience up to now. Use the Present Perfect.
